title: 第4章 戴夫
slug: 制霸好莱坞全本免费-制霸好莱坞最新章节列表
content_zh:
至于她，在穿越后还留在这里，完全是因为这家店的工资还算不错，虽然一个月内也遇到了两个自称星探和她搭讪的人，但陈贞对此都是兴趣缺缺，作为曾在电影学院上学，毕业后也和许多同学保持联系的圈内人，她深刻地知道几乎所有‘在街头被星探发掘’的故事都是炒作。
也许在电影这门行业刚开始，人们还没有意识到成为影星能带来多少好处的时候，制片公司的确派出星探在街头巷尾发掘有天赋的年轻男女，但在2001年的现在？起码电影这一行已经不需要星探了，反倒是唱片公司旗下还会有些厂牌在发掘新血，当然广告业和模特业也还维持了传统的‘星探’制度。但这种正规星探留的都是公司的固定号码，也会给名片，在餐馆和她搭讪的这种所谓星探，说穿了无非就是想要骗炮而已，更深一步的话，还想着骗钱也有可能。
这样的骗局虽然老套到二十世纪二十年代就有出现——即将在这两年的电影《芝加哥》中，女主角洛克希就毫不怀疑地被自称是制片人亲戚的推销员给骗了色，但时至今日依然是长盛不衰，在洛杉矶有太多自命不凡又满怀希望的男男女女，怀抱着明星梦在餐馆打工等待机会的绝非珍妮简一个，事实上，好莱坞之星的另一个当家女招待也和她一样有心往演艺圈发展，不过她的目标更切实一些，想要先进入广告界，从广告模特做起，再争取电视剧中的角色。
这是个不错的想法，但对陈贞来说毫无意义，原因也很简单——她没这么多时间了。
她是2014年穿越的，现在是2001年，满打满算也只有给她14年的时间，14年以后，她的一大优势便会消失，那就是她已经不知道什么片子会红，什么片子会扑街，为了不浪费这种先知优势，她不可能从电视剧做起再转大屏幕，毕竟几乎没有从电视剧出身的女演员在好莱坞称王称霸的先例，一部成功美剧如《老友记》，动辄就是七八年的拍摄周期，而且会把演员在观众心目中的形象定性，这对于演员本身来说是非常不利的，更别说从电视剧圈往电影圈转有多艰难了。
当然也没人靠当广告模特，当模特，拍真人秀，唱歌等等称霸好莱坞。
想要在好莱坞称霸，唯一的路就是演电影，她只能从电影起步，才有那么一丝微弱的希望在14年内起码把这任务完成个70%到80%。至于怎么登顶……这个事情陈贞自己都没想过，她连该如何量化这个目标都不知道。
即使只是眼前这‘演电影’的短期目标，都已经足够她喝一壶的了。
珍妮简服务了几位客人，用甜甜的笑容从他们手中得到了丰厚的小费，看看她负责的区域里大部分客人都在进食，她便暂且走到整理柜附近，靠着柜子休息一下酸疼的双腿，又开始机械地分析着自己接下来的路该怎么走。
要成为演员，当然要找个经纪人，经纪人掌握着试镜渠道，知道各种各样的试镜消息，能为她发出试镜申请，联系各种演出机会。如果她是经纪人看好的对象，愿意大费唇舌多方推荐，她甚至会在试镜中得到重点照顾……不过问题就是越有能力的经纪人对客户就越挑剔，以她现在这个层次，能找到的经纪人顶天了可以接到电视剧配角，这都还得是她特别走运，被经纪人看好的结果，如果不被看好的话直接就给介绍各种模特又或者是电视剧中的龙套为起步了。
不是陈贞太挑剔，而是在演艺圈，第一部作品是相当重要的，哪怕是演永远也不会上映的独立电影，只要你是演电影的，那么下一部戏还接到电影的几率就比较大，几部戏下来，便可以试着接演小制作的配角，然后是小制作的主角或大制作配角，最终到达大制作主角。——除非星运极强，遇到贵人直接跳过几步，否则大部分好莱坞的影帝影后也都是这么一步步摸爬滚打上来的。

content_en:
As for her, she stayed here after time travel entirely because the salary in this store was pretty good. Although she met two people who claimed to be talent scouts to chat with her within a month, Chen Zhen was not interested in them. As an insider who studied at a film school and kept in touch with many classmates after graduation, she knew that almost all the stories of "being discovered by talent scouts on the street" were hype.
Maybe when the film industry was just beginning, and people hadn't realized how many benefits being a movie star could bring, production companies did send talent scouts to discover talented young men and women on the streets, but now in 2001? At least the film industry no longer needs talent scouts. Instead, some labels under record companies are looking for new talents. Of course, the advertising and modeling industries also maintain the traditional 'talent scout' system. However, this kind of regular talent scout only kept the company's fixed number and also gave her a business card. The so-called talent scout who talked to her in the restaurant was just trying to cheat her out of money. If it went further, she might also be thinking about cheating her out of money.
Although this kind of scam has been around since the 1920s - in the upcoming movie "Chicago" two years ago, the heroine Roxy was undoubtedly deceived by a salesman who claimed to be a relative of the producer, but it is still popular today. There are too many pretentious and hopeful people in Los Angeles. Jenny Jane is by no means the only man and woman who is working in a restaurant with the dream of becoming a star and waiting for an opportunity. In fact, another hostess of Hollywood Star is also interested in developing into the entertainment industry like her, but her goal is more practical. She wants to enter the advertising industry first, start as an advertising model, and then strive for roles in TV series.
It's a nice idea, but it makes no sense to Chen Zhen, and the reason is simple - she doesn't have so much time.
She traveled through time in 2014, and now it is 2001. She has only given her 14 years. After 14 years, one of her advantages will disappear, that is, she no longer knows which movies will be popular and which movies will hit the streets. In order not to waste this prophetic advantage, she cannot start from TV series and then move to the big screen. There is almost no precedent for an actress who came from a TV series to dominate Hollywood. A successful American TV series such as "Friends" often takes seven or eight years to shoot, and it will determine the actor's image in the minds of the audience. This is very detrimental to the actor himself, not to mention how difficult it is to transition from the TV series to the film industry.
Of course, no one dominates Hollywood by being an advertising model, working as a model, filming reality shows, singing, etc.
If she wants to dominate Hollywood, the only way is to act in movies. Only by starting in movies can she have a faint hope of completing at least 70% to 80% of this task in 14 years. As for how to reach the top... Chen Zhen had never thought about this herself. She didn't even know how to quantify this goal.
Even the short-term goal of 'acting in a movie' is enough for her to drink a pot of wine.
Jenny Jian served several guests and received generous tips from them with a sweet smile. Seeing that most of the guests in the area she was responsible for were eating, she temporarily walked to the storage cabinet, leaned against the cabinet to rest her sore legs, and began to mechanically analyze her next move.
To become an actor, of course you need to find an agent. The agent controls the audition channels and knows all kinds of audition news. He can send her audition applications and contact her with various performance opportunities. If she is a favorite of the agent and is willing to go out of her way to recommend her, she will even get special attention in the audition... But the problem is that the more capable agents are, the more picky they are about their clients. At her current level, the agents she can find are amazing. She can get supporting roles in TV series. She must be very lucky., if the agent is optimistic about the result, if not, he will be directly introduced to various models or a small part in a TV series to start.
It’s not that Chen Zhen is too picky, but in the entertainment industry, the first work is very important. Even if it is an independent movie that will never be released, as long as you are acting in a movie, the chance of getting a movie in the next movie is relatively high. After a few movies, you can try to take a supporting role in a small production, then a leading role in a small production or a supporting role in a large production, and finally reach the leading role in a large production. ——Unless you are extremely lucky and just skip a few steps when you meet a noble person, most of Hollywood's best actors and actresses have also climbed up step by step.
